waivers.title: Nav links must be uppercase (CEO brand sheet: 'SHOP · STORY · CONTACT')
waivers.reason: Defect D-001 (requiring uppercase nav links) directly contradicts Locked Ledger decision A1, which explicitly forbids 'text-transform: uppercase' on all elements. Since A1 is a binding constraint and both reviewers have agreed to waive the defect due to this conflict, the defect is waived.
